en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Jarrrah Al madainy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is not correct to shout upon the deceased, nor is it befitting, but the people are not understanding, and the patience is better’.
en.sarwar: 12. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from al-Qasim ibn Sulayman from Jarrah al-Mada’iniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
howling for a deceased is not proper, and it should not happen but people do not know. Exercising patience is better.”
